coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .gitignore due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400), which incorrectly forced an inconclusive package verdict.
learnings: The audit tool should handle per-file LLM API errors gracefully, such as by retrying or skipping low-risk files, rather than allowing a single file failure to force an 'inconclusive' verdict for the entire package.
